On the French Riviera, movie producer Max Poulton (Stewart Granger) is on location shooting a film starring his lover, Gina Bertini (Gianna Maria Canale). But when the rueful Max ends his fling with Gina to return to his loyal wife, Carol (Donna Reed), the jilted actress threatens to reveal details of their affair to Carol. Later, at a party at Max's villa, investigator Carliss (George Sanders) arrives with news that Gina has been killed and that Max is a murderer suspect.

She is taken to a hotel room to hide until it is time for her testimony, and a romance begins to blossom between the superficially hard-boiled Sherry and police officer Vince Striker (Brian Keith). With time before the trial running out, Costain will stop at nothing to kill her before she can reach the witness stand.

Helm poses as a gangster, seducing Solaris' daughter, Suzie (Ann-Margret), along the way.

The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives.

Though haunted by combat memories, heroic pilot Ted Striker (Robert Hays) agrees to return to the cockpit to man the controls of Mayflower One, America's first commercial spacecraft. Gen. Aladeen (Sacha Baron Cohen) has ruled the oil-rich North African country of Wadiya since the age of six, when 97 stray bullets and a hand grenade killed his father in a hunting accident. After an assassination attempt takes the life of yet another body-double, Tamir (Ben Kingsley), Aladeen's uncle and most trusted adviser, convinces Aladeen to go to New York. Unfortunately, Aladeen has a less-than-friendly reception from exiled Wadiyans, who want their country freed from his despotic rule.

When she becomes aware of Jim's secret involvement in the race, a bitter feud is sparked.

A film capturing a journey across Korea, collecting the diverse sounds of everyday life and bringing them together to create a single piece of music.

Do Hyun realizes that another personality exists within him and comes to understand that it's “multiple personality disorder.” Tae Im brings Do Hyun back to Korea to protect the family's control over the company. Meanwhile, Ri Jin searches for her missing patient, Heo Sook Hee, at Club Paradise, where she unexpectedly runs into Do Hyun — but he seems like a completely different person.

Ri Jin is startled by Se Gi's completely different demeanor from Do Hyun's, but when he gets hurt during a sudden fight, she rushes him to the hospital. Ho Pil encounters Se Gi, mistaking him for Do Hyun. Meanwhile, Do Hyun decides to stay in Korea and join the battle for the successor position at Seung Jin Group. But after receiving a call that Ri Jin is being threatened by bikers, he tries to summon another personality.

Perry Park rushes to the scene despite warnings when he hears that a woman has been kidnapped by bikers. Ri Jin closely observes Do Hyun's completely changed demeanor. Do Hyun later attends the Seung Jin Group board meeting and is officially appointed vice president, but Tae Im slaps him in anger for being late.
A new personality appears in Do Hyun — this time, that of a young child — leaving him shocked. Meanwhile, Se Gi drags Ri Jin off to somewhere unknown.

Se Gi, who has kidnapped Ri Jin, asks her to make Do Hyun disappear forever. Director Ahn begins tracking their whereabouts. Meanwhile, Do Hyun ends up at Ri On's house, and Ri On introduces him to his family as “Mr. Perry.”

Byeok Gyesu's attempt to take Jini as his concubine fails. Infuriated, he orders the dancers to stop dancing and start pouring him some liquor. However, Baekmu argues that the dancers have to finish their dance.
Kim Jeonghan is busy preparing for the feast that marks the 20th anniversary of the rule of King Jungjong. Jini and Buyong are beautifying themselves to dance at the feast.
Three year alter, Songdo School has new leader and teacher. Geumchun needs Jini, and Hyeongeum is worried and misses Jini, who has no news whatsoever.
Kim Jeonghan diverts the attention of the officers to save Jini. Arrested, Kim asks Unam to take care of the geomungo. Jini sheds tears when she sees the writing of Kim Jeonghan on the instrument.

When Hurricane Katrina devastates New Orleans, four desperate friends band together to pull off a daring heist in the heart of the city.
Greed and betrayal ensnares three people (Danny Glover, Steve Zahn, Leelee Sobieski) when they find a stash of diamonds aboard a train.

New father Frank (Emilio Estevez) departs for a night out, joining friends Mike (Cuba Gooding Jr.) and Ray (Jeremy Piven) as they head to a boxing match. At the last minute, they are joined by John (Stephen Dorff), Frank's brother. Stuck in gridlock traffic, the guys take a shortcut that gets them lost. In a very dangerous neighborhood, they witness a murder by a gang leader called Fallon (Denis Leary). They flee, but Fallon now wants them hunted down and eliminated.

Police chief Xavier Quinn (Denzel Washington) investigates the gruesome murder of Donald Pater, one of the wealthiest residents on a Caribbean island. He was found decapitated in his Jacuzzi. Although the local political establishment, especially crooked Governor Chalk (Norman Beaton), insists that small-time thief Maubee (Robert Townsend) is responsible, Xavier has his doubts. This view is complicated by the police chief's personal history with Maubee: The men have been friends since childhood.

In a spoof of "Fifty Shades of Grey," Hannah Steele interviews entrepreneur Christian Black (Marlon Wayans) for her roommate's school newspaper. The wealthy and eligible Black quickly learns how clumsy the young woman is. As flirtation leads to attraction, Christian invites Hannah to his home and introduces her to his kinky world of S&M. Despite their different backgrounds, the new couple consistently surprise each other with how far they're willing to go to make their relationship work.

Finding she has some free time one morning, Strawberry visits Berrykin Bloom who is filled with excitement over his new crop of Berry Bitty fruits and vegetables  his garden has never grown so much produce! He can't wait to share his new crop (the perfect bitty size) with Berry Bitty City, so Strawberry volunteers to help him transport the produce to Orange's General Store.

Strawberry is really touched when her girlfriends and the Berrykins volunteer to help her with the construction of her new marketplace, so when the girls suggest they take charge of designing Strawberry's dream-bedroom to go on the second story, of course Strawberry agrees. While construction is going on, the girls each show Strawberry their individual ideas for the bedroom.

With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. The girls are blown away when their berryjuice cell phone gets a text message that Cherry accepts their invitation! Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

Cherry Jam is so enjoying staying in Berry Bitty City, that she calls her managers in Big Bitty City and informs them that she is going to stay for a much needed vacation! Strawberry and the girls are thrilled that she will be with them for a little longer, and they do all they can to make their guest comfortable. But Cherry doesn't want to be treated like a guest  she wants to fit in and contribute to the community.

Berry Bitty City is holding its first city-wide talent show! Hearing that it's the music students of superstar Cherry Jam, a talent scout from Big Bitty City plans to show up. Strawberry and her friends excitedly anticipate her arrival.

Raspberry is discovered by a talent scout who wants her to move to Berry Big City and design a new line of Glitter fashions! She will be provided with her own studio, staff, publicity, commitments from big department stores-everything she needs to be a big fashion designing star! All her friends are thrilled for her. Only Cherry is a bit less enthusiastic about Raspberry's stardom, which Raspberry mistakenly interprets as jealousy.

With the summer almost over, Blueberry overhears Strawberry talking about a wonderful tropical island and believes her friend is going to surprise them all with a much needed vacation! Blueberry makes the other girls promise to keep the secret until Strawberry reveals the big surprise. Of course, even though they've promised to keep the secret, they can't help but try and suss out what the island's like from every little thing Strawberry does.

It's the last week of summer and Berry Bitty City is hopping with activity as the girls prepare for their tropical island vacation at Berry Breezy Bay Resort. But just as they're about to leave, bad news: the resort is closed for the season due to berry breezy weather. The girls are disappointed, but Orange isn't giving up. She says if they can't go to the tropical island, maybe they can bring the tropical island here!

With only a few days of summer left, the girls are about to enjoy their first vacation in their newly-created, tropical beach resort at Berry Bitty Lake, when who should descend upon them but Mavis Maraschino, the comically over-the-top "Entertainment Tonight"-style show host. Mavis has dumped her focus on fashions in favor of an even glitzier show called Lifestyles of the Berry Big Bitty Stars, and she wants her first segment to be about how pop superstar Cherry Jam spends her vacation.

On a beautiful winter's night, Blueberry reads the Baby Berrykins a story of what happened one winter in Berry Bitty City-a winter that almost wasn't. Just as everyone is ready for winter fun and fashions, a sudden warming melts the snow and ruins their plans. Improvising with snowmen made of shaved ice and cotton puffs, Strawberry and her friends play "Capture the Snowman's Carrot Nose." The Berrykins want to join in the fun, so the girls play against them, with Strawberry refereeing.

It's another windy winter day, and the postal bees are staying indoors-the wind is too strong for their berry bitty wings. "We don't know when the next mail will get through!" It's bad news for Blueberry, who has been anxiously awaiting the next installment of a Patty Persimmon Detective story. If only she could get to the post office in Berry Bitty Dale where her package is waiting!

It appears winter is finally coming to an end and Raspberry is planning a big fashion show to display her spring line. Her vision is to have the girls model her fashions in a parade past the town fountain. What she didn't realize is that the Berrykins are turning the fountain into a big water show. Every time the girls come to rehearse, they must comically dodge jets of fruit juice from the out-of-control fountain-the Berrykins are still working out the bugs.

Strawberry, Cherry and the girls form a new band, Strawberry and the Sweet Beats, and prepare to go on the road to perform at the Opening Ceremony of the Berry Big City Games! While master mechanic Berrykin Bruce turns Cherry's tour bus into the band's hotel-on-wheels, Strawberry and her friends pack for the big trip. But the rest of Berry Bitty City points out that someone needs to run the girls' businesses while they are gone.

Berrykins Ed and Earl report to Princess Berrykin and Strawberry that they are certain there is a monster in the berry patch! They saw something with many noses and many tails making weird noises in the bushes. But upon further investigation by Strawberry and her friends, it is discovered that friendly boy Huckleberry Pie was driving his pet-mobile of orphan dogs through the countryside, took a wrong turn and got stuck near Berry Bitty City.

In Tucson, Pati learns the basics of artisan bread-making from Don Guerra of Barrio Bakery. She crosses into Sonora, Mexico, to see where the wheat is from. Back in her kitchen, Pati creates a menu of tasty recipes using wheat flour.
On the coast in Bahía Kino, local fishermen catch giant sea scallops. Then, in the mountain town of Matape, Nere, one of Sonora's few female butchers shares her wisdom with Pati.

Pati makes three classic Sonoran recipes: a fish special called pescado zarandeado, a rich stew called gallina pinta and a tasty dirty rice with clams. In Sonora, she visits vacation destination Puerto Peñasco.

Pati travels to Sonora's coast on the Sea of Cortez, where local legend Toño Contreras gives her a tour including shellfish on the beach, his restaurant Mariscos El Rey, and his home kitchen for some crave-worthy recipes.
Pati explores some unique spots in Guadalajara where food and art truly connect. In her kitchen, she makes pollo a la valentina, rice with poblanos and corn, and an almond tres leches cake.
Pati prepares a true Sonoran feast for the crew - Sonora cheese soup, chicken in pecan and ancho chile sauce.

Pati experiences the Escaramuza — An all-female horse riding and skills competition. In the kitchen, Pati makes Jalisco-style birria and her friend, pastry chef and cookbook author Fany Gerson, joins her to make gelatinas for dessert.

Pati meets the young chefs behind one of Guadalajara's most exciting restaurants, Xokol. Back home, Pati invites her friend Francisco Migoya over to make conchas to go with pellizcadas with chicharrón in salsa verde.
Pati learns about the history, the instruments, and the meaning behind Mariachi music. Pati makes carne en su jugo, tres chiles guacamole, and masa berry shortcake.

Pati explores the culinary highlights of Jalisco's capital city, Guadalajara. She starts at a street cart to taste the city's most iconic sandwich, tortas ahogadas. Then, she meets one of the city's best chefs, Fabian Delgado.

Pati spends a day in the kitchen with her middle son, Sami, cooking recipes inspired by her travels in Sonora that she knows he'll love - beef and potato chimichangas, rice with lentils and caramelized onions, and an avocado and radish salad.

Pati meets chef and historian Maru Toledo who is working to preserve and pass on some of Jalisco's most important regional recipes. Pati makes Jalisco-style chicken tamales and chile relleno rice dressed with salsa roja.

Pati makes traditional tamales with corn, chiles, and cheese, and then for the main course, pork chops topped with a pickled grape salad. In Sonora, she visits a traditional hacienda, where she gets a true taste of Sonoran ranch food.
Pati celebrates everyone's favorite Mexican creation, the taco. In her kitchen, Pati creates a pair of Jalisco-inspired tacos and a Ceviche tostada that are sure to satisfy any true taco-lover.

Three hairs microscopic fibers a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

Some people do get away with murderat least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programmes.st: Saving Light From a Black Sun
programmes.d: An attempt is made to fix the blinking sun of Seefra, but Trance is replaced by a doppelganger.
When Dylan is badly injured in a lab explosion, he travels through a series of alternate realities.
Rommie is rebuilt to help evacuate the Seefra system.
A warlord convinces his followers that the approaching destruction of the outer planets is a plot to make it easier to loot their planet.

programmes.st: Chaos and the Stillness of It
programmes.d: Dylan, Rhade, and Beka work together to rescue Trance from Methus-2 and Harper from General Burma.
The crew finally makes it out of the Seefra system, and discover Dylan is the last Paradine; the World Ship wasn't destroyed, and Nietzscheans have begun their plan to destroy Earth.
In the series finale, the final battle to save the New Systems Commonwealth begins.
After being left stranded near a black hole, Capt Dylan Hunt is discovered by a mercenary salvage ship to find he has been frozen in time for 300 years.
Dylan protects the Andromeda from the mercenaries while Beka starts to wonder if they are fighting for the wrong side.
Dylan finds a space station full of kids who believe he is there to bring peace by killing their enemies. He is manipulated into unlocking his weapons locker.
The crew of Andromeda is still learning how to work together as they are attacked by the Restorers.
The Andromeda gets involved in a feud between a Than planet and a Nietzschean colony. Tyr must choose between his clan or his new family aboard the Andromeda.
A slipstream sends the Andromeda back in time to just before the Commonwealth fell. The crew must intervene to preserve history.
Answering a distress call leads the crew to pick up Beka's brother, now a Wayist, and his friend. They are connected to environmentalists trying to prevent space travel.
A black hole allows Dylan to communicate with his former fiancee, 300 years in the past. He can't abandon his mission to reform the Commonwealth, but can he bring her into the future?
Dylan is imprisoned on a prison planet and must stage an escape as his crew tries to stage their own rescue.
Castalians board the Andromeda to finalize the charter for the New Commonwealth. When the leader is discovered dead, Tyr is the main suspect.

Having discovered there is more to skittish Doppio than meets the eye, Risotto uses his Stand to manifest various metallic instruments of torture from within his enemy. Fortunately for Doppio, a way to foresee the inevitable offers a glimmer of hope.

programmes.st: Under a Sky That Could Come Falling at Any Moment
programmes.d: A picturesque Sardinian cliff becomes the bloody backdrop to Doppio’s sudden dominance over Risotto, courtesy of Narancia’s own Stand. On the beach below, Abbacchio works to rewind time 15 years to identify the identity of a certain photographer.
Witness destiny unfold for Trish and the rest of Bruno’s team as her father’s cryptic presence and arcane abilities pull the crew into battles of unspeakable brutality.

programmes.st: Get to the Collessium in Rome!
programmes.d: With Abbacchio’s replaying ability interminably stamped in stone, Bruno and team analyze the cryptic face and fingerprints left behind when a mysterious call arrives.

No sooner than Bruno and team set foot on the shore near Rome the team finds a flesh-eating mold devouring everyone in sight. It's the work of Cioccolata, made worse by his partner Secco, who records the tortured faces of his victims to be viewed later.

Branching off from Bruno, who opts to tackle the underground swimmer Secco, Giorno and Mista chase Cioccolata as he flies to spread rotten ruin upon Rome. Their battles unfold in front of a mystery ally silently awaiting their arrival at the Colosseum.

One fierce battle ends in Cioccolata’s defeat, but another unfolds after Secco listens to Cioccolata’s revealing final voicemail. Bucciarati sinks into an intense underground struggle to stop Secco from reaching the secret stationed at the Colosseum.

The curtains are down on his skirmish with Secco, but Bucciarati must race against time to reach the Colosseum as he realizes his body is nearing the end of the line. Unfortunately, he’s not the only one who catches on to his deteriorating condition.

Key to defeating the Boss in hand, Polnareff waits for Bucciarati and crew. But the one who appears before him first is none other than the Boss of the Passione himself, Diavolo. The tides may not be the only things shifting in the battle yet to come.

Pierced by the arrow, Silver Chariot transforms into Chariot Requiem, its new power swapping the souls of all living creatures nearby. Realizing the dangers of the arrow in the wrong hands, Giorno and crew scramble to get ahold of it before Diavolo does.

Grotesque disfigurations begin to emerge from the soul-swapped bodies as Chariot Requiem’s frenzy rages on. Bucciarati and crew need to take back the arrow and fast. However, Giorno has a terrifying revelation, stopping everyone in their tracks.

Saitama's a guy who’s a hero out of boredom. After saving a child from certain death, he decided to become a hero and trained hard for three years to become 'One Punch Man.'
A monster is moving toward City Z, one created by the mysterious organization known as 'The House of Evolution.'
Saitama and Genos glean information about The House of Evolution and its founder, Dr. Genus.
Battlesuit-clad terrorists called "The Paradisers" appear in City F, led by an enormous man known as Hammerhead.
Cross Academy, consists of Day Class and Night Class sessions. Although the Night Class consists of students that are all beautiful, intelligent elites, they are in fact vampires!
Tomorrow is the annual St. Xocolatl’s Day, when it is customary for the girls at the academy to give chocolates to the boys.
As a duty of the Disciplinary Committee, Yuki and Zero must conduct a surprise inspection of the students’ belongings at both the Sun and the Moon Dormitories.
Seeing the state Yuki is in, Kaname takes her from Zero, who is left speechless when he realizes what he has done.
Brilliant but bored high school student Light Yagami suddenly finds himself holding the power of life and death in his hand, the power of the Death Note.
While the world's criminals continue to drop dead, L meets by computer with representatives from various nations.
Ryuk, the Shinigami, or god of death, who dropped the Death Note into the human world, warns Light that someone is on his trail.
Light, now known to the world as Kira, tests the Death Note to understand the scope of its powers by killing off six convicts in various ways.
Soichiro Yagami demands to meet with L in person when he finds out that L has secretly brought FBI agents into Japan.
Light meets a woman at the Police Department with an urgent message for the Kira task force.
Three girls, Ibara Naruse, Aoi Fukasaku, and Taeko Nomura, arrive in the ruins of the Old Capital, which was destroyed in an accident decades ago.
The girls encounter a couple named Mitsuo and Yukiko who are searching for their missing daughter Miku.
Vice Principal Mishima learns from the rescued Tanizaki about a man known as the Delivery Man believed to be their leader.
The Coppelion succeed in bringing down the monster crow, which then crash-lands in one of the Zones.
While heading to their next destination, the girls encounter a father and his pregnant daughter being attacked by a group of armed men.
Aoi’s careless action results in her being captured by the 1st Division.
A light in the sky, followed by a strange aura and grisly murders. Each character tells their own connection to the event and to a similar murder spree 5 years ago.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and David Harper, Day 3
programmes.d: Where there's muck there's brass! Rookie Angus Ashworth and old-hand David Harper buy chimney pots, vintage cases and an old washtub. But who'll salvage their fortunes at auction?

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and David Harper, Day 4
programmes.d: New expert Angus Ashworth and veteran David Harper are happy to be on home turf. David springs for a vintage trouser press, scales and a chestnut roaster, while Angus takes up the sword and powder flask as his auction weapons of choice.

programmes.st: Angus Ashworth and David Harper, Day 5
programmes.d: With his head full of saints and relics, newcomer Angus Ashworh is drawn to two rather gothic purchases, while David Harper gets in touch with his feminist side, snapping up some hatpins he thinks are of Suffragette origin.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 1
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst are having fun and chasing profits, from East Sussex to the coast of Dorset. Tim gets his hair washed while Catherine becomes a blacksmith.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 2
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst browse around Hampshire and West Sussex. But who'll be victorious at the auction in Hampshire?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 3
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst hit the shops, journeying from St Albans to Bushey in their safari-style classic car. Will antique biscuit tins prove to be profitable?

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 4
programmes.d: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst visit Worcestershire, Oxfordshire and Gloucestershire. Tim unearths what could be a Roman coffin and Catherine phones a friend.

programmes.st: Catherine Southon and Tim Medhurst, Day 5
programmes.d: A girl with some cherries lures Tim Medhurst to part with his cash, while Catherine Southon looks to a kaleidoscope for profit. Who'll reign in Wilshire and claim this Road Trip?

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 1
programmes.d: Veteran Road Tripper James Braxton tours the southeast with novice Izzie Balmer, an auctioneer with a penchant for jewelry. Will she take the crown with her jewels?

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 2
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer goes on a mission to Bletchley Park where codebreakers cracked messages from Hitler, while James Braxton dons a bandana and takes on English badminton.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 3
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer tries out a winter sport that began in the Fens. James is fuelled by the food of the common man. And they're buying chairs like they're going out of fashion for a Suffolk auction.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 4
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer and James Braxton visit the most easterly point. Izzie just can't resist the attractions of chairs -- Edwardian and Georgian. And James can't say no to a gigantic wine rack to go with his French cafe table.

programmes.st: James Braxton and Izzie Balmer, Day 5
programmes.d: Izzie Balmer is waylaid by the taste of Derbyshire and James Braxton takes a punt on some old headlines. It's full steam ahead to the finishing line at Lincoln. Can the tortoise outrun the hare?

programmes.st: Arusha Irvine and Angus Ashworth, Day 1
programmes.d: A new Trip sees experts Roo Irvine and Angus Ashworth searching for antiques in Northern Ireland. Expect silver jewelry and Victorian furniture made from an unlikely material.

programmes.st: Arusha Irvine and Angus Ashworth, Day 2
programmes.d: Roo Irvine and Angus Ashworth traverse southwest Wales in style, on land and on water. Angus buys cheap, while Roo buys big.

programmes.st: Arusha Irvine and Angus Ashworth, Day 3
programmes.d: Experts Roo Irvine and Angus Ashworth continue to scour the shops of south Wales for antiques. There are Welsh breakfasts, high-speed boats, and a little panic buying.

programmes.st: Arusha Irvine and Angus Ashworth, Day 4

When the son of a Russian gangster is killed at his own engagement party, Danny delves into the world of the Russian mob. Meanwhile, Erin is thrown into a high-profile corruption case.
A drug addict becomes the prime focus of Danny and Jackie's investigation after his girlfriend is kidnapped and held for ransom. Erin and Charles move past the flirting stage.
Is someone out to assassinate the Commissioner or was the shooting random? Danny takes on the assignment to find out the answer.
Nicky rides along with Danny to a crime scene where a girl at a debutante ball has been murdered and she has a difficult time coping after seeing her first murder victim.
As a former Marine, Danny feels personally responsible for finding the killer of a former U.S. Marine war hero. Someone has leaked false information to the press that Frank is going to run for mayor.
Just before Danny is to give witness testimony at a Peruvian drug lord's murder trial, Linda is kidnapped. This drug lord has a history of intimidating witnesses.
Danny and Jackie investigate the cut-throat world of fashion after Linda's runway model niece and a reporter are poisoned at a fashion show.
Frank's frustrations rise when the media sensationalizes the murder of a tourist shot and killed outside a trendy Lower East Side restaurant.
Neighbors of the Reagans are murdered and their son becomes the prime suspect. Jamie is convinced he's being pursued by the Blue Templar when his gun goes missing.
When a drug bust points to dirty cops, Frank decides not to involve Internal Affairs in the hopes of taking down and exposing the Blue Templar.
When a supporter for the mayor elect is found dead, Frank is put on the spot when the mayor wants him to position it to the public as a random act of violence.
When Danny shoots a cop who failed to identify himself, he is put on modified assignment and must face an Internal Affairs investigation, which delves into his personal state of mind that day.
When three men attempt to rob a bank, Danny discovers that one of the perps happens to be a former cop.
The peaceful world of a Ponderosa hand is disturbed by the arrival of his no-good father and twin brother, who is a wanted man.
Claude Miller, the laughingstock of Virginia City, gets even with everyone who made fun of him when he strikes it rich.
Classic comedy in which Hoss first meets prospector Obie and his lazy but allegedly brilliant mongrel dog, Walter.

Two robberies take place on stagecoaches that Adam is traveling on, and both times a knight in shining armor scares the robbers away.  Adam is accused of robbery, and his story about the knight is none too helpful.
Ben's plans to marry Katherine Saunders are upset when her son Eden is accused of killing his former girlfriend.
A peaceful Indian is framed for the kidnapping of a young girl, a stunt which ends of tragedy.

For a change, it is Adam rather than Joe who becomes mixed up in one of Hoss' funny exploits. Together they purchase a thoroughbred horse, and end up competing against their little brother in the big Virginia City race.

Kellie Conrad dances and her father plays the fiddle to earn a living.  Hoss feels a sense of guilt after he unintentionally hurts the arm that Kellie's father uses to play the fiddle, in a saloon fight with some roughnecks.
Professor Klump and Amanda pull Hoss into their flying machine scheme. The ""Hoss-mobile""doesn't seem to be destined for a great take-off.
Italian immigrants are determined to establish their own vineyard on Ponderosa property.
After a triumphant tour in Europe, a famous Negro singer encounters racial prejudice in Virginia City when he arrives for a concert.
Joe is goaded into facing gunman Dan Taggert, unaware there is more to be prearranged than he realizes.
As payment for a performance in a circus, Joe and Hoss are given an elephant.  They want to keep it but encounter opposition from Adam and Ben.
Little Joe's 19-year old girlfriend is killed by a good samaritan, an explosives expert who had stopped to render aid to the woman's uncle after he suffers a stroke.
When the woman he was planning to marry is strangled, Joe forces the only suspect to come forward.
No one in Virginia City is happy to see ex-con Trace Cordell, especially the man he crippled in a gunfight, now married to Cordell's former girlfriend.
Wiley and Annie Kane arrive at the Ponderosa to work off their father's debt to Ben. It seems as though the elder Kane once swindled the Cartwright patriarch.
Boruto is injured, unconscious and unable to continue. Everyone thinks about returning to the Hidden Leaf.
The team secretly enters the village determined to find Ohnoki, but they are unaware that they are being watched.
The team finds Ohnoki, but he flatly refuses to help. On top of which, they are attacked and separated.
Boruto and Ohnoki head to the rendezvous point, but they stumble into the Hidden Stone Shinobi Training Grounds
In order to get out of the barrier, Boruto desperately searches for his heart of stone, but he has little success.
Ohnoki takes Boruto to a special location to explain his vision of the future, formed after losing his grandchild, Kozuchi.
Kakou uses a rare and powerful Particle Style and pushes Boruto to the edge.
Boruto and Sarada are caught and taken back to the Hidden Stone headquarters along with Ohnoki.
Kirara appears and turns Boruto and Sarada into "dolls" that must obey her, ordering the two to kill each other.
Shocked and confused by the actions of Mitsuki, Sekiei recklessly attacks him.
Ku appears once again to provoke and attack Boruto.
Boruto and the other Leaf Genin return to the Hidden Leaf with Mitsuki
Boruto and his sister Himawari await Family Day with anticipation.

programmes.st: A Heaping Helping! The Eating Contest!
programmes.d: Boruto comes across an eating contest, held by the popular eateries in the Leaf for Parent and Child Day.

programmes.st: Tactics for Getting Along With Your Daughter
programmes.d: Boruto runs into his teacher Sasuke, who�s returned to the village after a long absence.
Worried that she will become a hindrance to missions, Namida decides to stop crying to prevent the jutsu from accidentally activating.
The Nara clan´s chief elder tells Shikadai to quit being a ninja and become a politician in order to increase the reputation of the clan.
Birds are attacking the residents of a village located on the outskirts of the Land of Fire. Boruto's and Sumire´s teams are assigned a joint mission to identify the cause.
Boruto and Sarada arrive at a certain location to see Jugo, following information gathered from the villagers.
Under Konohamaru´s orders, Sumire and the rest of Team 15 head back to report on the situation, but they are attacked by a mysterious enemy.
Sumire is able to escape with Nue´s help and begins searching for Wasabi and Namida and then Jugo´s friends Suigetsu and Karin suddenly appear.

Sarada and Karin struggle with fighting an enemy who is able to manipulate the power of the Curse Mark at will. Sumire fights alongside Nue to protect everyone, but Nue starts losing control of its powers.
Boruto and Suigetsu want to help Jugo, but they cannot due to the sedatives they were given. At the same time, the birds with the Curse Mark start flocking together to start their migration!

Team 7 is sent on a mission to help capture a jewelry thief, but they lose track of them. In the thief´s place, a cat appears. Boruto and the others decide that Mitsuki should take care of it for the time being.
Mitsuki visits Orochimaru´s research facility because he´s not feeling well. Mitsuki explains to Orochimaru and Log that he never used to dream during sleep, but has recently begun to have them.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The S-Rank Mission!
programmes.d: Konohamaru´s cousin, Mirai Sarutobi, is assigned to escort the Sixth Hokage Kakashi and his friend Might Guy to the hot springs.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Dog and Cat War!
programmes.d: Mirai and crew arrive at the hot springs located near the border of the Land of Fire and the Land of Steam in time for a festival celebrating dogs and cats.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Haunted Inn!
programmes.d: A few days into the mission, Mirai visits the hot spring with Tenten, Guy´s former student. But that moment of relaxation is interrupted by Guy yelling about a ghost.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Potato Chips and the Giant Boulder!
programmes.d: Mirai, Kakashi, and Guy travel with Tatsumi to a village with a secret hot spring, but they find the hot spring covered by a boulder!

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: The Resurrection Hot Springs!
programmes.d: Moved by Tatsumi´s efforts to accomplish her goal all by herself, Mirai decides to help her even though she's still in the middle of her mission.

programmes.st: The Steam Ninja Scrolls: Mirai's King!
programmes.d: Mirai leaves the inn with Tatsumi without telling Kakashi and Guy. At the hot springs Mirai thinks she sees her father Asuma, but something feels off.
Naruto and Shikamaru deliberate on the results of the Chunin Exam that were left unsettled due to the Otsutsuki attack.
With Shikadai as captain, Boruto, Iwabe, and Wasabi form a special team for a mission to find and bring back a rare flower that only blooms for a short period of time.

When MacGyver agrees to bail out an old buddy, he winds up on a rescue mission in Central America to save another old buddy from drug smugglers.
MacGyver and Pete Thornton travel to Southeast Asia to rescue a group of orphans, a nun, and Mac's old flame, Debra Easton, whose lives are threatened by an oppressive regime.
MacGyver and a deaf school teacher, Carrie Linden, live out a nightmare when they stumble upon an ex-CIA agent's ingenious plan to steal a missile, piece by piece, and sell it on the black market.
A senator's drug-addicted daughter is killed during an altercation with her father, but a senior aide covers up the incident as an overdose.
Dr. Sloan and a headstrong attorney (Piper Laurie) investigate a drive-by shooting at a high school.
Robbie runs for student council.
Steve must escort the daughter of a visiting dignitary.

Dennis uses his friend’s remote control to operate Mr. Wilson’s television from his house, and Mr. Wilson can’t understand what’s happening.
Dennis asks a reporter to write a story about his dad with hopes of getting his picture in the paper.
Dennis and Tommy collect newspapers for a paper drive that will reward the boy who collects the most with a silver dollar.
Bud loses the money he was supposed to use to pay the tailor.  One of the Carnival booth owners cons him into thinking that he can work for him to earn the money back.

programmes.d: Betty is saddened when her new boyfriend, who is a jet pilot, is transferred to Alaska.

programmes.t: Father Knows Best: An Evening To Remember
programmes.d: Actor Cornell Wild gets in an accident and asks Jim for legal advice.

programmes.st: What Did You Do in the West, Uncle?
programmes.d: Bill takes a week of vacation and plans activities for each day. The Rodeo is in town and Bill's friend Gabe is one of the cowboys. Bill invites Gabe to stay with them and the twins want to do everything with him.

Bill thinks the twins take advantage of him and French because they give in to their every wish. Bill says to deny the twins sometimes so they do not get spoiled. Buffy and Jody make a trophy for their uncle, but get sick from the clay.
A friend of Bill's is an actor who wants to shadow Mr. French in preparation for a movie role. Meanwhile, Cissy has trouble finding someone to ask to the Girls Tag Day Dance.
When a neighboring family has a baby, the children start to ask questions about where babies come from. Uncle Bill has to explain.
Peter is made fun of by his teammates for joining the glee club.
Greg gets caught with cigarettes in his school jacket. He's been caught smoking once before (and quit immediately). Therefore, nobody believes him when he truthfully says they're not his.
Jan wears a brunette wig in hopes of being noticed.
Greg moves into the den and transforms it into a mod-pad.
Marcia joins a boy scout troop to support women’s lib.
A terrified Cindy is having trouble sleeping with the lights off as she is scared of a magic trick she saw at a friend's party.
Mike is set to go down to the blood bank to donate some blood and asks Archie if he would like to donate.

Gloria comes home from the doctor with some news: she's pregnant. This leads to a big argument between Archie and Mike so Mike decides to quit school and move out. Archie doesn't believe him until Mike gets a job in Detroit and plans on moving there.

programmes.st: Mike's Hippie Friends Come To Visit
programmes.d: Just before leaving on a flight to Europe, Mike's hippie friends need a place to stay for the night. Mike invites them to stay in the Bunker's living room, however, Archie objects citing that no unmarried couple will spend the night under his roof.

Archie discovers that a new family is moving to the neighborhood. He goes over to investigate, only to discover that the new family is black. Archie quickly hopes to round the neighborhood up and try to force the family out of the area.

Edith is all excited that she has been chosen for jury duty. When Archie realizes that she may be sequestered, he forbids her to be on the jury, wanting to keep her at home to cook and clean for him. When she is sequestered, Archie fends for himself.

programmes.st: Archie Is Worried About His Job
programmes.d: Archie stays up all night, expecting a phone call from a security guard who has information. It seems his company is laying off and he fears he may lose his job. No one else in the Bunker household can sleep either and it turns into a three ring circus.

Gloria has been reading books on women's lib and encourages Edith to try a little liberation. However, Mike won't take any of her ideas, which leads to huge fight in which Gloria demands that Mike recognize her as an equal partner in their marriage.

Archie is all set to go to the Mets game; however, Edith has different plans after she accepted an invitation to dinner with the Jeffersons. Archie discovers this and comes up with the excuse that Edith sprained her ankle, thus turns down the invitation.

When Verna May Rae passes on, Mama finally gets the opportunity to sing "Raytown, O Raytown" on Founder's Day. It's been 50 years since she first auditioned, and this time she will stop at nothing to win.

programmes.st: Breaking Up Is Hard to Do
programmes.d: Finances not only cause Vint and Naomi to separate but also force them to remain living at home with Mama. Mama, on the other hand, is so miserable that she has no alternative but to force them back together.
After attending a big wedding, Bubba, Iola, and Mama each fantasize about what it would be like to be married and each realizes that, for now, that "heaven can wait!"

When the Tri-State fair comes to Raytown, Mama takes in weekend boarders in order to buy a new stove. All "bed" lam breaks loose when they overbook and the family winds up sleeping together in the same room.
Vint is so embarrassed when Mama brings his childhood lunchbox to work that he accidentally cuts his finger and takes it to his bed, refusing to go back to work.

Tchaikovsky's only violin concerto, Op. 35 in D major, was composed in 1878 in Clarens, Switzerland while he recovered from his failed marriage; it is one of the best-known violin concertos.
All your favorite characters from the world of cartoons and animated films in the concert hall, together with a strong fusion of musicians and singers from DR's choirs and orchestras.

A performance filled with unforgettable voices and expressiveness.
College student Brad Perry shows up to work his graveyard shift at the gas station and is never seen alive again.
When 25-year-old school teacher Christy Mirack is found murdered in her apartment in 1992, there is no shortage of suspects.

Just two years into their marriage, Chuck and Cheryl Hall are torn apart when Chuck finds Cheryl murdered. Though Cheryl's family is certain they know her killer, the law isn't as sure. After several decades, a DNA match erases all doubt.
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo. A closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

When 36-year-old computer programmer Lisa Valdez fails to show up for work, her apartment manager finds her brutally murdered. Detectives ask, could she be the victim of a brutal serial killer? Or was Lisa murdered by someone she knew?

A forensic dentist helps police nab a child killer by showing that the teeth marks on the killer's arms match the teeth of the murdered boy. And telltale blood stains on a blue bandana solve the 10-year-old case of a teenage girl murdered.

DNA found on a marijuana joint in Florida in 2005 helps to solve the 1988 rape and murder of a California woman. And a cold case of murder in Illinois heats up when a jailhouse lawyer turns jailhouse snitch.

Police run down more than 11,000 leads before coming up with a suspect in the murders of three Virginia girls, and the abduction and strangulation of a California woman continue to baffle the investigators more than 11 years after the crime.
Forty-one years after the crime, a woman implicates her brother and cousin in the murder of a policeman.

Easter Sunday of 1992, the body of missing woman Lisa Ziegert is found in a field. The investigation yields hundreds of leads but no true suspect. After more than two decades on ice, the case is revived.

Cops finally close in on a serial killer with the help of the Internet. And a drug trafficker jumps bail goes into the bike shop business and helps pioneer the sport of mountain biking while he's on the lam.

When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August of 1986, residents of Tacoma panic. This is the second young girl killed in five months. Convinced a predator is loose, Police embark on a 32-year inquiry.

This is the story of the hunt for one of the most notorious serial killers in American history--the BTK killer. After committing at least seven brutal murders he vanished for over 25 years before sending clues of his crimes to the media in 2004.

programmes.st: Diary Of A Serial Arsonist/The Lost Clue
programmes.d: A highly-regarded California arson investigator is suspected of setting a series of fires, and in Texas, a man is convicted of raping and murdering his 68-year-old neighbor.

A murderer's saliva, found on envelopes, helps seal his doom 37 years after his first killing. And Colorado police crack a cold case 24 years later when they take a DNA sample from the victim's son that proves that his father murdered his mother.

A detective vows not to shave until he solves the murder of a young Oregon woman. It takes three years and a string of Mexican Mafia informants to crack the case and allow the dedicated detective to shave his beard.
A dry cleaning tag inside a sweatshirt left at a crime scene helps police track down a serial killer and rapist who had been eluding them for years.

When Jane's brother Trent is asked to perform at the Alternapalooza music festival with his band Mystik Spiral, Jane and Daria decide to accompany them on the road.
The girls meet Ilana's 16th cousin – who is a Holocaust survivor – and take him to a drag brunch; Abbi tries out a new look.
Ilana gets recruited to be a hair model; Abbi's new flame tells her that she's not mature enough.

What's that funny sound coming from Yellow Valley? Dora and Boots set off to investigate.
Dora brings Boots a special present, a new floaty that will help him swim. Boots is thrilled, and they set off for the beach.
Deedle dee dee! Dora and Boots hear the ice cream truck nearby, but they just miss it.
All aboard! It's time for the big train race. The first train to the Big Yellow Station wins a big whistle.
Dora and Boots find a blue key; it turns out it's the key to a big treasure chest.
Dora and Boots are at the farm today, bringing presents to the three little piggies.
Boots loses one of his shiny red boots in the Big River. Dora and Boots set off on a wild water adventure as they chase the runaway boot.
Dora and Boots go hunting for blueberries on Blueberry Hill. But they'll have to be careful—Swiper the fox lives on Blueberry Hill!
Dora and Boots meet Wizzle, who lost his bag of wishes and can't get home. Our heroes, Dora and Boots, set off in search of the lost wishes.
Dora and Boots set off to deliver a basket of treats to Dora's Abuela to help her with her cold. Dora's mother warns her to watch out for Swiper the Fox. He'll swipe the treats.
It's Boots' birthday! Dora tells him that all his friends are waiting at her house to give Boots a big party.
Benny the Bull needs some sticky tape in a hurry. His hot air balloon is leaking and floating toward Crocodile Lake! Dora and Boots rush off to rescue their friend.
Boots buys a super blue bouncy ball at the store, but it bounces off down the hill.
Dora remembers the first time she met her friend Backpack. Backpack is helping Dora carry her books back to the library. Can they reach the library before it closes?
Dora and Boots offer to help Mama Bugga Bugga bring a giant cookie home to feed her babies.
Dora and Boots go on an underwater adventure that takes them all the way to the bottom of the ocean.
Dora and Boots are getting ready to make a wish on the first star in the sky when the star falls! It's up to Dora and Boots to bring Little Star back home to the Moon.
Dora and Boots must go into a storybook to rescue a prince from a wicked witch.
In this version of the famous Puerto Rican legend, Dora and Boots find a sad, homesick little coqui who's lost his voice. Dora and Boots offer to take the frog home to his island.
Abuela tells Dora and Boots about a magical chocolate tree that lived near her house when she was a little girl. Dora and Boots set off into the forest to find it!
El Mago, a mean magician, casts a spell on King Popo and Queen Maria, turning them into mountains so they can never be together. Can our heroes break the spell?
When young Pablo loses his magic flute, a terrible drought hits his family's farm. Dora and Boots find Pablo's flute and hurry off to return it to Pablo on his mountain.
Dora and Boots keep running into friends in need of help. Turns out the other animals are all headed to a big party at the Treehouse. They beg Dora and Boots to come too!
Boots is thrilled to hear about the riddle contest today at the Tall Mountain. Who can solve the silliest riddle?
Uh oh! A big storm cloud is coming. Dora and Boots have to warn all their friends in the forest to get home fast so the big storm cloud doesn't rain on them and get them wet.

Boots can't wait for a super-duper toy fire truck that's coming in the mail. But when the package arrives, the box is empty! Seems the toy fell out and is now sitting far away on top of Snowy Mountain.

The stick, the stick, the magic stick! Dora and Boots find a magic stick, and according to the wise old tree frog, it's up to our two young heroes to go to the top of the highest hill to make the stick do its magic trick.

¡Falta algo! Something's missing! Dora and Boots meet a wizard, El Encantador, who's missing his magic wand! Dora and Boots set off on an educational adventure to find El Encantador's wand so he can do his magic.
Squeaky, squeaky! What's that sound? It's Squeaky, Boots' adorably squeezable new bath toy. But when Boots loses Squeaky, we all have to head to the Gooey Geyser to get him back.
Meet Rojo, the newest, shiniest red fire truck. Rojo invites our heroes along as he goes on his very first rescue mission—to help a kitten who's stuck in a tree.

Who do we ask for help when we don't know which way to go?  The Map! But today the Map gets mistaken for a stick by a goofy bird. The bird flies Map all the way to his nest on top of Tallest Mountain.
It's Mother's Day, and Dora wants to help Papi bake Mamá a special cake. But three key ingredients are missing: bananas, nuts, and chocolate.
Go, go, go, Golden Explorers! Dora and her friends have formed a soccer team and are playing the big dinosaurs. Can Dora kick the ball into the net and score a goal?
¡Feliz Navidad! It's Christmas Eve, and Dora and Boots are going all the way to the North Pole to deliver a present to Santa.

The Cattle Drive continues with various difficulties to overcome, including conflicts between Matthew and Sully, cattle rustlers, hungry Indians, and a prairie fire. Dr. Mike delivers a calf, and Sully helps her clean up afterwards.

Dr. Mike has a hard time accepting Dorothy's decision not to have the surgery that will save her life. Jake tries to escape the two men who kidnapped him.

After his devastatingly fast, samurai-style combat approach sets filmmakers against him, a legendary action star (Tak Sakaguchi) films his own movie—on turf claimed by feuding yakuza gangs, including Japan’s deadliest martial arts assassin.
The film revolves around the story of Phi - a retired martial artist, longing for a peaceful life with a beautiful wife named Lanh.

programmes.st: Pink In The Middle/Pink In The Poke

'A Nut at the Opera': When stage hand Pinky accidentally puts the opera's star tenor out of commission and must take over the lead himself. 'Hamm-N-Eggz': Hamm and Eggz royally mess up the wedding of the obnoxious daughter of a Mafioso hit-man.

Inspector Gadget saves Professor Frafkin, the world's leading scientist, from being kidnapped by Dr. Claw.
Inspector Gadget and Penny head off on a vacation in the country when they get a frantic call from the Chief that Dr. Claw has stolen an experimental missile.

Mr. Bean builds a supermarket super trolley. Nipping to the shops for a few provisions becomes a nightmare when a mile-long shopping list from his landlady and a clapped out trolley with a wonky wheel conspire to ruin his day.
Mr. Bean is forced to look after his worst enemy. After a head-on collision with the milkman, Mr. Bean’s landlady is rushed to hospital, leaving him to look after her odious one-eyed cat Scrapper.

Mr. Bean gets in a complete flap when he befriends a feathered thief. When nursing an injured magpie in his room, Mr. Bean learns something the rest of us already know: magpies can’t help stealing anything that sparkles.

Mr. Bean loses his bottle. Mr. Bean is delighted with his new ‘ship in a bottle’ until it mistakenly ends up on a milkman’s float. He frantically pursues his prize possession, only to see it disappear into a milk bottling plant at the local dairy.
When a young woman collapses in the town square of the Transylvanian town of Poenari, it is discovered she has a vampire bite on her neck!
When Sam's Uncle Paul, a caretaker at The Winchester Mystery House in San Diego, starts seeing ghosts, she must defend his sanity to save his job.
Queen Mab is abducted and the Banshee suspect the Alliance...
Blaze and the Banshee warriors prepare to attack the Alliance for kidnapping Queen Mab...

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Happy Families

Rikki and Bella hide out at Cleo's to protect themselves from a full moon water attack. However, Bella is kidnapped by a water tentacle and taken to Mako Island. Lewis tries to keep Will away from the island so the girls can rescue her.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programmes.d: Cleo defies Lewis' advice and experiments with the magic Moon Pool water. Using her powers, Rikki accidentally gets the water into Cleo's aquarium and all the girls have to rescue Cleo's fish Hector.
Bella's warned to back off from Will as he's on the trail of the girls' mermaid secrets. She gets too close to him and he finally discovers she's a mermaid.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Just a Girl at Heart
programmes.d: Bella helps Will with his free-diving training but when she realises he's more interested in her as a mermaid than a girl, she's hurt. Rikki and Cleo have to improvise when the cafe's first corporate function is actually a children's party.

programmes.t: H2O: Just Add Water: Crime and Punishment
programmes.d: Rikki receives counterfeit money at the café and is held captive by criminals on a boat. Bella and Cleo are forced to reveal the trio's secret to Will, so they can rescue Rikki together.

An undefeated Blader named Zyro Kurogane travels to a big city, where he loses his first battle to a famous Blader by the name of Shinobu Hiryuin.
Zyro tires of training and challenges Eight to bey battle in the Cyclone Beystadium.
Benkei sponsors a one-day bey tournament, where Zyro defeats Shinobu in the final to avenge his earlier loss.
Zyro battles Kite and defeats him, but in a rematch, Kite claims victory to even the score.
In a rematch, Zyro uses Synchrome to combine his bey Ifrit with Shinobu's bey Salamander to defeat the Unabara brothers' bey Orochi Leviathan.
Benkei continues to train Bladers, with Kite, Eight, and Ren joining Shinobu, and Zyro.
Sabrina is shocked when Salem shows up at the witches’ academy one day and tries to hide him from the faculty.

Sabrina’s tired of sharing Harvey with all of his extra activities: sports practice, science club, after-school job at the local market, etc. But when she casts a spell making her Harvey’s top priority, she gets more than she planned on.

Sabrina knows there’s a big assignment due at school - a term paper on a world conqueror. (She chose Attila the Hun, thinking he’d been given a raw deal by history; she’s going to tell the true story.
Sabrina finds a forbidden spell book on Mr. Snipe’s desk and casts a spell to make him fall in love with the first person he sees.
Hilda & Zelda have been warning Sabrina about using magic she’s not ready to use.
Archie buys a pair of mystical fuzzy dice for his beloved car, Betsy, and unwittingly brings her to life when he hangs the dice on her rearview mirror.
Veronica treats Jughead like an outsider and excludes him from her guest list for a pool party she's throwing, on the basis that he's different.
In an effort to catch both Veronica and Betty's attention, Reggie attempts to steal some of Dilton's physique enhancing solution.
Rikki comes to stay at Emma’s house and stirs up the family unit. In trying to compete with Rikki, Emma tries to rebel and throws a party. Nate uses Lewis to make a play for Cleo.

Lewis finds an old book on mermaids and tests out a potion recipe on the girls. Cleo tries to get Don and her Mum together by using her powers to grant him a wish. Realising it’s not what he wants, she finally accepts the situation.
While Frasier frantically prepares to host an important party, Niles tries to dissuade Daphne from pursuing a romance with Frasier's contractor.
Labor relations go from heated to hot and heavy when Frasier and his boss negotiate a staff raise -- and an unexpected passion for each other.

programmes.st: The Adventures of Bad Boy and Dirty Girl

programmes.st: The Last Time I Saw Maris

Realizing that it's time he started dating again, Niles takes Daphne to a society ball.

After Daphne gets dumped by her boyfriend, Niles decides it's time to declare his love for her.
Frasier and Lilith join forces so that their son can gain admission to the most prestigious private school in Boston.

programmes.st: Dad Loves Sherry the Boys Just Whine
programmes.d: Frasier and Niles disapprove of Martin's relationship with his brassy new girlfriend.
Frasier finds himself in a precarious position when he tries to help the troubled marriage of a former high school acquaintance.
When Frasier becomes fed up with the rules and regulations governing his condominium complex, he decides to run for condo board president.
When Eddie shows signs of depression, a pet therapist thinks Martin's dog is simply reacting to the dysfunctional Crane family!
When the Crane brothers go away for the weekend with two attractive women, Niles discovers he hasn't quite cut his emotional ties to Maris.
A comedy about a stunt man who’s never successfully landed a jump without wiping out and his attempt to master the biggest stunt of his life.

Melinda must help Ned stop a ghost out for revenge.
Melinda must discover the truth hidden within a new family.
Melinda discovers a family secret as madness grips the hospital and the town.
Ned's Occult Anthropology professor is stalked by the ghost of a secret admirer.
A ghost confides in Melinda that a bomb is missing from a munitions dump.
A routine estate sale lands Melinda in the center of dark forces battling for a little girl's soul.
Comic book artist Damon Weaver begins drawing his own run-ins with ghosts before they happen.

When a confused ghost dressed as a clown begins haunting Melinda's house, it's up to her and Eli to look for answers in the ghost's final case as a private investigator - a love story involving greed and suspicion.
Aiden is put in danger and Melinda seeks the reason why.
A fun night out turns dangerous for three teens and Melinda investigates.
A ghost Melinda is trying to help suddenly turns up alive.
Melinda's investigation of a poltergeist in the hospital leads to a showdown.

Melinda Gordon has always had the ability to see and talk to dead people. These earth bound spirits, the ones who have yet to cross over to the other side, seek Melinda's help in communicating with the living and resolving unfinished business.

Melinda helps a boy reassure his mother that his death was not her fault, while also preventing the boy's father from seeking revenge on the man who sold them the broken down car that took part in his death.

When a teenage psychiatric patient, Natalie, escapes, her rebellious ghost twin asks Melinda for help, claiming Natalie doesn't belong in the clinic. Their parents placed her there for believing she can still feel Zoë's presence.
Melinda agrees to help a deceased fiancé communicate with his grieving fiancé and find the man who received his heart donation, in an effort to bring closure so they can both move on.
When Sam and Jay invite their nosy neighbors to a dinner party to woo them into allowing the bed and breakfast, the ghosts are desperately eager to be included on the guest list.
On Halloween at Woodstone Mansion, the ghosts try to help Sam and Jay protect their home from the neighborhood kids who vandalize it every year.
Pete convinces Sam to invite his living wife to the mansion, only to discover she's been keeping a dark secret from him for many years.

When Sam is commissioned to write an article about Flower and her friends holding up a bank during their commune days, Flower begs Sam not to accept the job because she's embarrassed about a part of the story she's never revealed.
After Jay is kicked out of a Dungeons & Dragons campaign with his city friends, Sam agrees to facilitate a new one between him and the ghosts.
Alberta is thrilled when a super-fan of her music visits the mansion to learn more about her. Also, Thor convinces Hetty to go for a walk with him, hoping it will spark a special memory.
Hetty accidentally possesses Jay's body just as he and Sam are about to show Woodstone Mansion to a renowned wedding planner.

Ricky cannot help Fred out by performing at his lodge show because he is already booked for a radio show that day. Lucy volunteers to help out so she and Fred whip up a Western act. Ricky discovers it's a rodeo show that he's booked for, not a radio show.

Ricky finds Lucy exhausted after a trying day with little Ricky and insists it is time their son started nursery school. Lucy's protests are overridden and Ricky takes young Ricky to nursery school, but the baby comes down with tonsillitis.

Ricky is offered a European booking that is too important to refuse but he can't afford to take Lucy with him. Lucy is furious at the prospect of being left behind, and when Ricky wants to take Fred Mertz along as the tour manager, Ethel too, is incensed.

Fred's fear of becoming seasick threatens the Mertzes' and Ricardos' plans for Ricky's European band tour. They are all booked on the ocean liner Constitution for the trans-Atlantic voyage.

The Ricardos and Mertzes are on the deck of the Constitution, ready to set sail for Europe when Lucy rushes down the gangplank for one last goodbye to Little Ricky who will be in her mother's care while she is away.

Lucy anticipates a 2nd honeymoon with Ricky on their boat trip to Europe, but Ricky's band duties keep him too busy. Lucy happily looks forward to romantic evenings and daytime deck games on board the ship as the Ricardos and the Mertzes sail for Europe.
Lucy is thrilled at being in London, and most of all wants to see the Queen. She misses the Queen at Buckingham Palace where she and Ethel try to make the guard smile.

Lucy is jealous after Ricky dances with Angela Randall, an up-and-coming British actress. She gets Ricky away from her by going to the country estate of Sir Clive Richardson, a prominent English film producer, for a fox hunt he is hosting.

The Ricardos and Mertzes prepare to leave London for Paris, Lucy realizes that they will not have time to visit her ancestral land of Scotland. She was looking forward to seeking out members of the McGillicuddy clan, her distant relatives.
Equipped with an English-French dictionary, Lucy sets out to explore Paris and discover an artist whose paintings will become very valuable – she knows she has "the eye."

The Ricardos and Mertzes, sightseeing in Paris, are sitting at a sidewalk cafe that Charles Boyer is known to frequent. Lucy thinks she has spotted Boyer and turns to jelly, but Ricky convinces her it's a case of mistaken identity.

Lucy goes on a hunger strike in order to get Ricky to buy an expensive dress from a famous French designer. He finally gives in but returns the dress when he discovers that Ethel smuggled her food while on the strike.

Fred, managing Ricky's band while on European tour, routes the musicians to Locarno instead of Lucerne. Ricky is distraught and Lucy suggests a hike in the Alps with the Mertzes to take his mind off his problems.

Ricky is working in Monte Carlo, but Fred goofed and bargained for too little money for the engagement. Lucy and Ethel go to the casino to watch, but when Lucy finds a chip that someone dropped and replaces it on the table, it wins and continues to do so.

Mt. Hakurei's holy barrier prevents demons from entering it. Saint Hakushin helped Naraku, and placed the barrier.
Mt. Hakurei gets stronger, and Kikyo is prevented from going into its hold ground.
Suikotsu cannot kill Chiyo and the others. Jakotsu stops him. He senses an attack from Sesshomaru.

programmes.st: Vanished in a River of Flames

programmes.st: Into the Depths of Mt. Hakurei
programmes.d: The evil within Mt. Hakurei is Naraku's demons and Kagura. Miroku risks his life to save Sango, by opening his Wind Tunnel and sucking in the demons.
Miroku and Sango come face to face with the Saint Hakushin's mummy on Mt. Hakurei. The saint tells them his reason for helping Naraku.
Inuyasha regains his demon powers. He defeats Jakotsu, and hurries to Mt. Hakurei. Renkotsu has rebellious feelings towards Bankotsu.
In the middle of the night, Jane gets a burst of creative energy and starts her thesis. Unfortunately, Mateo spills orange juice all over her computer causing it to lose all her hard work.
Jane's crush on Professor Chavez is popping up in her dreams and she needs to evaluate her feelings. Xo and Jane find Liliana's engagement ring and think that Rogelio is going to propose.
Jane is considering whether or not to take her relationship with Jonathan to the next level and turns to Xo for advice. Xo and Rogelio have their own relationship issues to work out.
Jane and Michael are back together, almost! Jane attempts to get Rafael and Michael to reconcile, but it doesn't go well. Rafael sulks over losing Jane and ignores Petra's pregnancy needs.
Jane and Michael are back together and Jane wishes she had never left Michael in the first place. Rafael appears to have regressed to his playboy ways and Petra is concerned about him.
Rafael and Petra are new parents but Petra is already back to work and appears to be not interested in motherhood. Xo has invited Alba's old flame Pablo to visit.
Jane and Michael's wedding plans are side tracked when the Villanueva house is ruined by a flood. Jane wants a small wedding, but Rogelio wants to throw Jane a big blow out wedding.
Jane has a specific idea of how she wants to celebrate her bachelorette party, but when Xo and Lina get involved, nothing goes as planned.
After Jane and Xo's fallout from Jane's bachelorette party, Jane now needs to someone to watch Mateo. When Michael volunteers to help everything is perfect until Mateo does something.
Jane takes on additional shifts at the Marbella to make extra money, but it cuts into her time with Mateo. Jane and Rafael agree to a formal custody agreement and decide to use a mediator.
The Villanueva women have a tradition for Mother's Day and Jane is excited to participate as a new mom. However, their plans are thwarted when Petra invites everyone to a brunch instead.
Jane has made big plans to celebrate Mateo's first birthday, but things start to fall apart when she learns there might be an issue with her wedding venue.
After moving up the wedding day, Jane and Michael find all their carefully made plans thrown into chaos. To make matters worse, Jane is unhappy with her current graduate thesis.

Jane discovers that Michael was shot and finds herself having to make difficult choices. With Rafael focused on keeping Mateo safe, Anezka, who is pretending to be Petra, "helps" the cops with their investigation.

When Rafael finally admits that he is over Jane, their co-parenting style is tested when they argue over what the best preschool is for Mateo. Xo is paranoid about Alba finding out her secret and what it will do to their relationship.
Jane continues to work on her thesis and she decides to add Alba's estranged sister to the narrative, much to Alba's dismay. Rogelio tries for his chance at being an American crossover star.

Jane and Michael's housewarming party hits a snag when they discover they are being evicted for not paying their rent. Rogelio is still trying to break into American television, but needs some unusual help from Rafael.

A team of six clever kids enacts a daring plan to track down a swindler and bring him to justice.

An 11-year-old girl moves to a suburb of Washington, D.C. with her father Ben and her 17-year-old brother Lester.

When a spaceship crashes into their barn, animal friends set out on an incredible adventure

Ninjago has become a bleak, enemy-occupied city ruled by Emperor Garmadon and his Sons of Garmadon biker gang.
Jay, Kai and Zane are interrogated by Iron Baron, the ruthless warlord to the Dragon Hunters. Feeling threatened, the Ninja choose to keep their identities secret.

As the Ninja are put into a cage aboard a hunting party, they learn that their elemental powers will be used to help lure a dragon. Undercover, Cole learns Iron Baron is in search for Firstbourne’s nest – the Mother of All Dragons.

After a flashback of when Jay first meets Master Wu, Jay awakens to find he’s still with his caged friends returning from their hunting party. Forced into slave labor, Jay’s inspired by his dream of his master when Wu told him to ‘build the impossible’.

Dareth warns his friends just as the Sons of Garmadon ambush their secret headquarters. The Elemental Masters are each captured, except for Lloyd, Nya, Dareth and Skylor, who escape within Nya’s escape vehicle.
As Lloyd and his friends lick their wounds, Mystake shares how she managed to escape the Sons of Garmadon earlier -- she’s a shape-shifting Oni.

Time is running out. But if the heroes can discover the locations of the fabled and powerful Fire Wings before the Hunters reach Mount Cavora, they may still stand a chance. But to do so, they must learn to think like Phoenix.

It is Chima's coldest hour … The Hunters have launched their final attack on the Lion City and Mount Cavora. The Tribes, aided by the Phoenix, fight bravely, but all hope rests on uncovering the rest of the eight ancient Fire Wings.
Laval the Lion and Cragger the Crocodile are the best of friends. But when young Cragger becomes king of the Crocodiles, he tries to conquer all the Chi. Former friends become the worst enemies.

King Cragger’s mischievous sister Crooler uses a mysterious plant to cloud Cragger’s mind. This causes him to cause mayhem at the ceremonial CHI day Speedor races, and he plans a massive attack on the Lion Temple.

Cragger tricks Laval into withholding CHI from the Crocodile tribe. This reignites the hostilities between the Lions and Crocodiles. Laval must frantically escape the wrath of the Crocs and somehow get rid of the CHI before his father finds out.

Laval and Eris take a Lion tank for a ride around Chima. But it may not be such a good idea. During their trip, they discover that Cragger has employed a tribe of beavers in an elaborate plot to steal all the Chi.

Each month there is a big market at the Speedor races. Laval and Eris go there, but Cragger has hired the Ravens to steal Laval’s precious Speedor. And suddenly the prize of the races, the Golden Chi, has also disappeared.
The Dream Chasers rush to crack the code to reveal Lunia's secrets while the Nightmare King presses a full-scale assault on Castle Nocturnia.
The Nightmare King begins to open a rift to the Waking World while Mateo presses Oz for the truth about Lunia's battle with the Nightmare King.
A night terror is on the hunt at the fall festival and so is the Night Hunter, who appears in the Waking World with a brand-new threat for Mateo.
The barrier to the Waking World has been torn and the Nightmare King invades Brooklyn, where the Dream Chasers must make their final stand!
Missing Z-Blob, Mateo tries to free him to the neglect of his dream chaser duties while the team wrestles with an incursion case and a flock of unusual ravens ignites Izzie's suspicions.
Oz takes the dream chasers to Castle Nocturnia to meet Grand Inspector Royce. Zoey heads to the Grim Realm to confront the Night Hunter and the rest of the team consults the enigmatic Sandman.

When the Murky Realm disappears, a student's intense daydream results in dangerous sirens and the dream chasers must keep hapless students and teachers safe as Mateo faces pressure to meet his dad's new girlfriend.

Garmadon is enraged by the loss of Harumi and releases his wrath by ordering the Oni Titan to turn Ninjago City to ash. Lloyd fears they won’t be able to endure much longer – where are his friends?
